knowledge:
- key_parameters: exprSet=An ExpressionSet containing the genomic feature expression data (exprs) and phenotypic endpoint data (phenoData) ;; geneSet=A GeneSetCollection object containing gene sets for GSEA, or NULL to perform gene-level analysis only ;; promise.pattern=A data frame defining the association pattern, specifying the statistic coefficient (stat.coef), statistic function (stat.func), and endpoint variables (endpt.vars) ;; strat.var=Variable used for stratification (set to NULL if no stratification is needed) ;; proj0=Logical; if TRUE, performs a projection to point 0 (ignoring stat.coef when prior biological knowledge of endpoint association direction is unavailable) ;; nbperm=Logical; if TRUE, uses a fast negative binomial permutation sampling strategy to stop permutations early for features with a fixed number of successes ;; max.ntail=Number of successes (tails) required to stop permutation early when nbperm=TRUE ;; nperms=Number of permutations to perform ;; seed=Seed for the random number generator to ensure reproducibility
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when you want to identify genomic features or gene sets associated with multiple clinical or phenotypic endpoints simultaneously according to a predefined biological pattern (e.g., positively associated with drug level, negatively associated with residual disease, and positively associated with survival).
- pitfalls: The array IDs (column names of exprs) and patient IDs (row names of phenoData) must match exactly. The probe IDs in the GeneSetCollection must be a subset of the probe IDs in the ExpressionSet. If prior biological knowledge of the endpoint variables is not available, proj0 must be set to TRUE so that stat.coef is ignored; otherwise, an incorrect arbitrary pattern might bias the projection.

workflows.name: promise_analysis_without_gsea
workflows.intent: Identify individual genomic features associated with multiple phenotypic endpoints according to a predefined pattern without performing gene set enrichment analysis.
input: pattern_definition.csv (association pattern coefficients and functions for each endpoint)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the PROMISE package and construct the ExpressionSet from expression and phenotype data ;; 2. Define the association pattern data frame mapping endpoints to statistical functions and coefficients ;; 3. Run the PROMISE function with geneSet=NULL ;; 4. Extract and inspect the gene-level association statistics and permutation p-values.
workflows.code:
library(PROMISE)
data(sampExprSet)
data(sampGeneSet)
data(phPatt)
test1 <- PROMISE(exprSet=sampExprSet,
                 geneSet=NULL, 
                 promise.pattern=phPatt, 
                 strat.var=NULL,
                 proj0=FALSE,
                 nbperm=FALSE, 
                 max.ntail=10,
                 seed=13, 
                 nperms=100)
gene.res<-test1$generes
head(gene.res)
set.res<-test1$setres
head(set.res)

workflows.name: promise_analysis_with_gsea
workflows.intent: Identify both individual genomic features and gene sets associated with multiple phenotypic endpoints using projection-based statistics and fast negative binomial permutation.
input: pattern_definition.csv (association pattern coefficients and functions for each endpoint)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the PROMISE package, ExpressionSet, and GeneSetCollection ;; 2. Define the association pattern data frame ;; 3. Run the PROMISE function with a GeneSetCollection, enabling fast permutation (nbperm=TRUE) ;; 4. Extract and inspect both gene-level and gene-set-level results.
workflows.code:
library(PROMISE)
data(sampExprSet)
data(sampGeneSet)
data(phPatt)
test2 <- PROMISE(exprSet=sampExprSet,
                 geneSet=sampGeneSet, 
                 promise.pattern=phPatt, 
                 strat.var=NULL,
                 proj0=FALSE,
                 nbperm=TRUE,
                 max.ntail=10,
                 seed=13, 
                 nperms=100)
gene.res2<-test2$generes
head(gene.res2)
set.res2<-test2$setres
head(set.res2)
